layers.label: Flood — 5-year return period
layers.note: Clipped from 3 province-level features; 0 were dropped after the bounding-box pass. 3 feature(s) fell back to a bounding-box clip because the upstream contour could not be intersected exactly (it self-intersects), so their outer boundary may include a sliver of a neighbouring municipality. 129317 polygon piece(s) whose interior point fell outside the Labo outline were discarded, so hazard belonging to neighbouring municipalities is not shown here. Simplified at 0.0003° tolerance to keep the layer under 8.388608 MB. Hazard classes follow the Project NOAH legend in the per-layer readme PDF that ships inside the province archive.
